what_it_does: Introduces PatLabor, an algorithm for designing routing trees (the branching patterns of wires connecting circuit components) that optimally balance wirelength versus signal delay. Traditional approaches use tunable parameters to guide this trade-off but cannot compute all optimal solutions at the boundary of feasibility. PatLabor directly computes the full set of Pareto-optimal solutions (no solution improves one objective without worsening another) with guarantees on execution time and solution quality for nets with up to nine pins.
